text: You say "a heavy-volume reclaim is an automatic rally inside markdown." My method lands in the same place by a different test: elder_5d [10, 10, 7, 6, 10] with CORRECTION_REENTRY and mp 78.0 STRONG is a clean force reclaim, but force alone is a fragment (C9). With ma_50 80.24 under ma_200 87.31 the average falls, so C10 permits only shorts, and BEARISH_CHOCH suppresses the long (R11). HOLD OPPOSE. What turns me: a served rising average with structure no longer bearish, then a fresh <=6 to >=7 elder event. Cannot see: weekly tide (R6), impulse colour (R1).
